Product Description Standard Models
Arbin's Laboratory Battery Testing (LBT) series offer industry-leading hardware LBT 25V - 10A
with high-precision measurements and high-frequency data sampling. LBT 25V - 20A

most complex research experiments or real-world test applications. LBT 25V - 100A
Technology engineered for LBT was commercialized from a successful ARPA- LBT 40V - 20A
E project for which Arbin and its industry partners Sandia Nat'l Lab and Ford LBT 40V - 75A
won an R&D 100 award. Arbin's LBT provides true bipolar circuitry to ensure LBT 40V - 150A
cross-zero linearity with no switching time between charge and discharge. LBT 60V - 15A
We invite battery researchers and engineers to compare our I/V control LBT 60V - 50A
performance and see for themselves why it is trusted around the world more LBT 60V - 100A
than any other tester.
Product Highlights
 Each channel provides three or four current ranges with industry-leading
 0.02% accuracy.
 Powerful embedded controllers provide ultra-fast data logging (up to
 2000pts/sec, per system).
 Easily simulate custom EV drive profiles or stationary grid storage profiles
 without complicated scripts.
 Fully parallelable so any number of channels can be connected to
 increase the current handling capability.
 Dynamic data acquisition based on changes in time, voltage, and
 current to capture more data when it's needed and maintain efficient
 file sizes.
 Full set of auxiliary options for cell monitoring, temperature monitoring,
 environmental chamber control, and more.
